clips.title: The story
paras: At Westfall Lighthouse, Captain Grayson keeps watch over the beacon that failed him. His ship smashed against the dark coastline, and now he tends the light so other sailors will not meet his fate.

Captain Grayson once sailed the southern seas of the Eastern Kingdoms as a ship’s captain. One night, the lighthouse fire went dark as his vessel neared Westfall’s jagged shoals. The ship struck the rocks, and Grayson died with it. He awoke as an earthbound phantom, trapped upon the coast.

In death, Captain Grayson went to Westfall Lighthouse, hoping to learn what waited beyond life. There he saw Old Murk-Eye, a notorious murloc, drive away the keeper and his family. The brave keepers returned to rekindle the flame, but Old Murk-Eye rallied the surrounding murlocs and led a second, brutal slaughter. Grayson could only watch as the family was butchered.

With the keepers dead and Westfall crumbling under neglect, Captain Grayson bears the beacon’s solemn burden on his spectral shoulders. He asks passing travelers to gather fuel for the great flame. He also seeks vengeance for the slaughtered family: hunt down Old Murk-Eye and drive back the coastal murlocs.
